name: Apple Picker
storyline:
"The nitrogen in their DNA,
the calcium in their stems,
the potassium in their flesh,
and the iron in your apples
were made in the interiors of collapsing stars.
Apples are made of starstuff.
You aren't just picking apples.
You are harvesting the universe."

Adam Sagan
summary: Start with an apple tree, end with a multiverse turned to pulp in this creepy idle incremental game. Pick apples. Produce more apples. Cause the apple-fication of reality. Uncover the source of this all-consuming apple obsession. But whatever you do, (don't) shoot the unicorn.
